pillars.name: Content accuracy
pillars.description: every factually wrong statement, wrong number, wrong definition, and every claim that its cited reference does not support (claim-support mismatch), anywhere in the book

9-10.text: No factual errors or claim-support mismatches found on a full read.
9-10.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band

7-8.text: Isolated minor inaccuracies that do not mislead the reader.
7-8.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band

4-6.text: Several errors, or one that would mislead a reader acting on it.
4-6.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band

1-3.text: Frequent or dangerous errors; the text cannot be trusted as written.
1-3.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band

hard_caps.description: An open safety blocker caps content accuracy at 4.

pillars.name: Pedagogical design and clarity
pillars.description: objectives, structure, progression, cognitive load, readability, figures' teaching value

9-10.text: Clear objectives, logical progression and readable prose pitched at the stated audience throughout.
9-10.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band

7-8.text: Sound structure with some uneven chapters or dense passages.
7-8.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band

4-6.text: Objectives or progression are weak in many chapters; readability often above the audience.
4-6.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band

1-3.text: No usable learning design; structure or level does not fit the audience.
1-3.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band

pillars.name: Assessment quality
pillars.description: questions, distractors, rationales, key balance, alignment to objectives

9-10.text: Every item is aligned to an objective, with plausible distractors and full rationales.
9-10.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band

7-8.text: Mostly sound items; some weak distractors or thin rationales.
7-8.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band

4-6.text: Many items misaligned, trivially guessable or without rationales.

pillars.name: Sources and currency
pillars.description: reference existence and metadata, recency against brief.references.recency, evidence hierarchy, citation coverage (claims that need a citation and have none)

9-10.text: Every reference exists with correct metadata; recency target met; claims needing a citation have one.
9-10.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band

7-8.text: A few metadata slips or uncited claims; recency close to target.
7-8.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band

4-6.text: Many unverifiable references, outdated evidence or uncited claims.

pillars.name: Mechanism and drug-class coverage
pillars.description: Mechanisms of action explained correctly and clearly at receptor and pathway level, and every drug class of each chapter covered with its main members (not single-statement correctness, which is G1).

9-10.text: Every class covered; mechanisms precise, visual and linked to effects.
9-10.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band

7-8.text: Classes covered; a few mechanisms thin or not linked to effects.
7-8.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band

4-6.text: Missing classes or mechanisms stated as lists without explanation.
4-6.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band

1-3.text: Mechanisms absent or confused across most chapters.
1-3.evidence_required: cite the finding IDs (or state that none were found) that justify the band
